Title: Oracle PL/SQL Developer 
 Location: Cincinnati, OH 
 Duration: 12 months+ (High probability of extension) 
 Need GC and USC 
 Top Desired Skills: Oracle Development, PL/SQL 
 Job Description:
 We are looking for an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer with at least 7+ years of hands on IT experience.
 Desired Experience:
 - 7+ years of PL/SQL experience
 - The developer must be familiar with reading entity relationship diagrams and have table/view/index design experience
 - The developer must have experience with performance tuning of PL/SQL and SQL code.
 - Data Warehouse experience
 - Unix shell programming (Plus)
 - Ability to communicate complex technical subject matter to different audiences
 - Ability to absorb new technical information and can apply it effectively
 - Ability to demonstrate initiative and a pro-active approach 
 - Aptitude for diagnosing and understanding complex issues.
 - Proven track record in the analysis, design and implementation of complex, large scale data solutions
 - Ability to mentor and/or help train others 
 - BI development experience (Nice to have)


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to preethib @usmsystems(dot)com or call me on  703 468 0398
